reviews.text: This is a must have when you visit Cape Town, from the airport transfer to local safari or wine tasting, I have never had such quality service and with a luxury feel. 100% will use the day I go back and highly recommend to all future travelers!
Thank you very much for a good service and organization, the bus was new and clean, the driver was punctual polite and positive!

reviews.text:
After a disappointing Cape Town tour on Thursday, October 29th, I knew I wanted and needed something different than what I experienced that day. Even though I paid for the following day, I forfeited the payment and searched for something new. So, I returned to my hotel room at the One & Only, and began my mad dash to find another tour operator at 4pm for the following morning. It was very last minute.
The reviews for Cape Town Concierge were glowing, so I decided to book them. The online response to my request was immediate, so I began to feel hopeful.
As promised, my tour guide arrived on time and ready to go. I met the incredible Nawaaz and felt his infectious positive energy from hello. I still didn’t know that I was going to spend the next 10 hours with the most incredible tour guide I have ever booked. To say the day was spectacular would be an understatement. Nawaaz was so knowledgable, kind and patient. His service was VIP+++ and I would never visit Cape Town and not request him. I could have spent several days with him, if I had more time in this fabulous city.
If you are considering booking a tour in Cape Town, I would only call Cape Town Concierge. If you’re fortunate, you’ll get Nawaaz. I’m 100% convinced, they don’t come any better!

Cape Town Concierge Team was so easy to connect with for our VIP Transfer requirements. Very prompt responses and the chauffeur, Dylan provided great service and timely updates regarding the services. Highly recommend for VIP transfers in Cape Town! Look forward to working with you again.
We had a great time, many thanks to Nawaaz, who showed us Capetown with passion and also with his knowledge about everything in this special region! Great time! Surely we’ll repeat!

Wanting to try something different!!! One of the best recommendations I would say. 4 days spent with this amazing team, showing me around Cape Town and Hermanus. Truelly loved it. If you haven’t tried them u definitely missing out. Can’t wait to do it again..
We did a wine tour and Cape Tour with Cape Town Concierge. Both were amazing. Our guide, Dylan, was amazing. Very knowledgeable, personable, and helpful. Would highly recommend!

We had a fantastic experience with Cape Town Concierge Car Service! Aadil was phenomenal- professional, friendly, reliable, and an absolute pleasure to work with. He made getting around Cape Town so easy and enjoyable for our family. Thank you so much, Aadil, for taking such great care of us! We highly recommend this service to anyone visiting Cape Town.

The service Cape Town Concierge provided was wonderful. From the first message we sent them to the final hugs at the airport with our driver, Nawaaz, nothing was too much trouble. We had the good fortune to have Naz look after us and take us to all the wonderful spots Cape Town had to offer! He was warm, engaging, funny and hugely knowledgeable about his city and the people in it.
I would even go as far as to say that Naz made our holiday perfect. Without him, we would not have seen half of what we did. I would strongly recommend everyone use Cape Town Concierge for your next trip to the beautiful city. It was true value for money and you will not regret a minute of it.
Thank you so much for all you have done for us over the last few days.
Paul, Nicola, Joshua and Isabel

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Unforgettable South African Experience with Dylan! 🇿🇦❤️
A heartfelt thank you to Dylan, our wonderful chauffeur and guide throughout our South African journey! He made our entire trip incredibly smooth, exciting and memorable... His professionalism, kindness, patience and genuine care made us feel comfortable and well looked after every step of the way... What touched our hearts the most was discovering that Dylan is truly an animal lover... Being passionate animal lovers ourselves, we instantly felt a special connection with him... His compassion and love for animals made us appreciate him even more. ♥️🐾
He wasn’t just our chauffeur; he became such a lovely part of our South African memories... His thoughtful nature, positive attitude and dedication made every journey enjoyable...
We couldn’t have asked for a better person to accompany us throughout this beautiful country...
Thank you, Dylan, for making our South African holiday so special. We will always remember your kindness and warmth. Highly recommended! ❤️🇿🇦♥️

We had a great experience with this chauffeur service in Cape Town. Mohamad was extremely professional, attentive and reliable throughout. Communication with the company was also excellent - they were always very quick to respond and easy to deal with. The car was comfortable, spacious and in great condition. Everything ran smoothly and we felt very well looked after. Highly recommend!

We had a fantastic day with Mohamed who took us down the cape and stopped at little villages along the way. He was informative but not in your face- he totally understood our vibe. He took some pics for us and was such a genuine and kind person. We would highly recommend him and this company. Communication was also very good. Car clean and well presented.

Totally worth it! We booked a driver and car for a full week and immediately noticed that it made the trip what it was. Cape Town is amazing, but there is a lot of ground to cover. Having a driver certainly made the experience unique and flexible. We got to know our driver, Rafiq, so well. He truly became a part of our family, not just for the trip but forever. I can’t imagine a more kind and hospitable person than Rafiq. He was consistently 30 minutes early and was ready and available the entire time. Ask for him if you can! Hands down, 10 out of 10. We will be going back and will certainly utilize this service.

My daughter and I used this company for 3 days while in Capetown! Dylan was our driver and we could not have felt more safe! He was thoughtful, kind, knowledgeable, and had great recommendations!
We would both give this company 10 stars! I will admit they were a bit more price wise, but after meeting Dylan we never gave the price a second thought!
Thank you Dylan for a wonderful trip and all the great memories and conversations! We will always remember you with fondness!

We’ve just come to the end of a wonderful day trip around Cape Peninsula with Nawaaz who has been an amazing guide and driver. He is an extremely knowledgeable and very enthusiastic guide and we can highly recommend him and Cape Town Concierge

We had a wonderful experience with Best VIP Chauffer in CPT. It was easy and convenient to complete the booking through WhatsApp, and our driver was waiting for us in arrivals area at the airport on time. Dylan, our driver, was very knowledgeable about CPT and made our experience touring the city feel fun and safe. We highly recommend giving them a try! -Cole and Sarah-Lee
Quality of personnel’s service was superb

My experience with Dylan was fantastic; he’s an excellent driver and outstanding tour guide, with impeccable manners, professionalism, and great customer service. He was helpful and friendly, ensuring our comfort throughout the trip, and he introduced us to the tourist attractions in an enjoyable and informative way. I highly recommend him, and thank him for the wonderful trip.

I’m so glad I booked this! Everything was perfect, from the schedule and photography to the restaurant and snack recommendations. Thanks to you, it was the best day ever. Safety and service were all top-notch!

Cape Town Concierge came through for me in fine form on short notice for a chauffeur and car for a day in the Cape wine lands. Their communication was excellent and their performance exceeded not only my expectations but also their stated standards for themselves.
Their services, while not inexpensive, are fairly priced, especially considering the level of service and communication provided. I will use them again next time I am in Cape Town.

We had Dylan as our guide for the day we went to Boulders beach, Chapmans peak and Cape of good hope - and everything right from the ease and transparency in booking to prompt arrival in the morning to communication - it was amazing. Best of all was Dylan’s attitude and bright smile right from the moment we met him in the morning to the amazing pictures he took for us and right until he dropped us off at night - What amazing energy! And how involved he was in making sure we were comfortable throughout and had a great day. I would recommend Dylan to anyone looking for a tour guide in and around Cape Town!
It was truly a wonderful experience. The car was very comfortable, and the driver was a respectful person who knew the area well. It was a fantastic experience indeed.

Extremely quick communicators with an excellent roster of drivers. They got back to me as soon as I reached out and have been very communicate about setting up our tour of Cape Town. We had a wonderful experience seeing Kristenbosch Botanical Garden, the Boulders Beach Penguin Colony, and the Cape Point Nature Reserve with our kind, prompt, and knowledgeable guide Mohamed. Highly recommended if you are in Cape Town and tight on time!
The best

Mo was an excellent driver and made our time in Cape Town even more enjoyable. He was always friendly, flexible, and happy to adapt to our wishes. He shared lots of interesting information, took us to great places, and recommended a fantastic restaurant. The car was comfortable and everything was perfectly organized. We highly recommend Mo to anyone visiting Cape Town! 😊
Responsive, professional, and punctual. Excellent quality; we recommend them

Dylan was an amazing driver and tour guide. He took my family and I down to Boulder’s Beach, the Cape of Good Hope and Chapman’s Peak. He also help organize our transfer to the Weinlands, including some lovely wine tasting and lunch spots. He’s full of information and a delight to spend the day with. Highly recommend!

I’m incredibly grateful to the company and our driver, Mohamad! Firstly, the price was very good. I’d say the best! Secondly, Mohamad was very friendly, kind, and caring. Even though we don’t speak English well, we felt like his friends. Thank you so much! We’ll definitely contact you again when we’re in South Africa. The best!

reviews.text: Great service, honest and reliable

Magnificent service!! I researched several VIP transportation services. Cape Town Concierge was truly reliant and exceeded expectations in every possible way. We toured Cape Point all the way to The Cape of Good Hope. Great restaurant recommendations, and always patient with my family’s requests. Thank you Dylan!! Thank you Cape Town Concierge!! Gracias 🇲🇽 🇿🇦

Our experience was honestly top-tier. From being punctual and professional to just having the best energy, Dylan made our entire trip soo smooth and enjoyable. You truly added to the whole experience with your recommendations, patience and attention to detail.
You made every ride comfortable and safe and that meant everything especially since we were exploring a new city.
Thank you for going above and beyond. We couldn’t have asked for better!
Highly highly recommend!

I cannot recommend this company enough. We had the airport run booked amazing! Two tours booked so seamless and amazing we cannot thank you enough! Nawazz was absolutely fabulous made our stay here in Cape Town Perfect. 110% recommendations thank you x

Dylan was amazing. He made every moment seem as exciting as the first… his attention to detail, his personalized care and ability to go out of his way to make sure that we were comfortable and enjoying ourselves was exceptional. Highly recommend Dylan for any event.
Dylan was so professional, super helpful and so fun to hang around! Would recommend his services 1000%

Hhad such an amazing experience with Dylan. He’s kind, so cool, very respectful, and genuinely such a great person. From the start, he was very helpful showing us around, sharing history, and taking us to the best spots for cute pictures like Quinn Rock.
He aLao allowed us to truly be ourselves - we felt so comfortable the entire time.
His energy was unmatched man! He was always on time, very patient, and a careful driver the girls and I felt completely safe with him. And we absolutely loved his car… the BMW was such a vibe 😮‍🔥
He played great music for us, which made everything even more fun. Overall, I had such a good time with my friends, and Dylan was a big part of that.
Highly recommend, thank you so much, Dylan!

We booked a multi-day trip along the Garden Route and it exceeded our expectations. The scenery along the coast was incredible and the chauffeur service made the long drives relaxing and enjoyable. We visited Knysna, Mossel Bay and several beautiful viewpoints along the way. Highly recommended if you want to explore beyond Cape Town.

What we loved most was the flexibility. Mohamed created a custom itinerary that included Table Mountain, Constantia wine farms and a sunset drive along Chapman’s Peak. The whole day felt tailored to our interests. It was like having a local friend show us the best parts of Cape Town.

The Cape Peninsula tour was one of the highlights of our South Africa trip. We drove along Chapman’s Peak Drive, visited Boulders Beach to see the penguins and continued to Cape Point. Having a private chauffeur meant we could stop for photos anytime and enjoy the scenery without rushing. Absolutely worth it
Ali is a great driver: safe, quite, clever and helpful to explain the different options during the visit. The car was clean and safe. I recommand to everyone Ali as a driver.

Ali did a great job driving us on a full day from Cape Town to Cape Point, stopping off along the way. He was highly attentive, had a great manner and did not rush us. Ali also had some fantastic recommendations which were a highlight!

Dylan was an exceptional chauffeur in Cape Town!! He was incredibly friendly and professional. He was very knowledgeable about the city and made great recommendations throughout our trip, helping us make the most of our day. He was extremely flexible and accommodating to our different schedules. Easily the best service in Cape Town and would 100% recommend!!!

10 out of 10 experience!! Dylan provided quality service and went over the top numerous times to make our experience the best it could be. From coordinating between everyone in our group on everyones various excursions, knowledge of Cape Town to avoid traffic so that we could make the most of our one day in the city, to the overall great vibes he brought. Dylan stresses excellent service and hospitality and this was very clear in our experience of him. Will be using his service again and highly recommend!!
Dylan was absolutely fantastic. Flexible, Friendly, Polite, Patient. Professional and the price 👌

reviews.text: Great chauffeur service! Quick replies and easy to contact. Very efficient in organising the day trip would recommend to anyone!

If you are looking the BEST most professional & prompt car service in Cape Town - look no further from pick up to drop off… Dylan was an absolute joy! Not to mention the amazing comfortable SUV and playlist - best experience. We booked him twice. 😎👌🏽🥰🏁

I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better personal driver! From the moment we arrived, he made us feel so welcomed with snacks and such a friendly attitude. He showed us around Cape Town Mountain Views and even took us on safari, which made the whole experience so special and unforgettable.
We had great conversations throughout, and he was always patient, helpful, and professional. He went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and enjoying every moment.
I would 100% recommend him to anyone visiting Cape Town and looking for a reliable, friendly, and amazing driver. Thank you for making our trip so enjoyable
Unreal experience, looked after so well, perfect for wanting to see so much in a day. Mohamad was the best!

The best in the game... I forgot my phone in Nadeem car and he brought it to the airport for me what can I say I trust him with my life and so should you, very informative and knows so much about cape town.... thanks VIP chauffeur and private tours in cape town...
Nadeem was super friendly, professional and made the time to go out of his way to show attractions that we would have missed. He felt like an extended family member! Highly recommend you will regret!
Perfect for business travel. The driver waited for us, helped with luggage, and the car was clean and comfortable. One the highlights of my trip to Cape Town. Fantastic experience with them
We loved every bit of it and “Mo” our transporter/tour guide and all round gentleman was fantastic! We will be back!
I booked my Safari Chauffeur with these guys and would highly recommend

We had an incredible experience with Mo during our trip to Cape Town! He is highly knowledgeable about the area and gave us fantastic recommendations for everything from restaurants to attractions. He drove us to multiple locations, including some amazing restaurants and even a safari, making our visit truly unforgettable.
His vehicles are exceptionally clean and well-maintained, and we especially loved riding in his BMW X5, which added an extra touch of comfort and style to our journeys. Beyond that, his honesty and professionalism stood out, and we always felt safe and well taken care of.
If you’re looking for reliable, top-tier transportation in Cape Town, we cannot recommend Mo enough. He truly made our trip exceptional!

We met Nadeem in Cape Town as someone had recommended him and me & my niece truly had the best time ever as Nadeem was so flexible and very friendly and knew every corner of Cape Town! I highly recommend him to get a great experience in South Africa! We will be back again hopefully soon 😋
Thank you so much Mohammed. You were very good and cooperating. I appreciate it
He was very good and cooperating. Thank you so much. Batman 😂
10 stars. I could be your biggest fan, I will shout it from the top of table mountain, you are INCREDIBLE

Mo is the best driver. He takes extra care, is always on time, ensures his passengers are safe and drives very well! I always recommend Mo to friends, family and people visiting Cape Town. 10/10 experience, always.
The most respectful and an absolute amazing guide 🤍🤍🙏🏽

Thank you, thank you and thank you 🙏🏻❤️❤️
Honestly, I didn’t expect the service to be with this quality and professionalism, and I’m one of the critical people in the field of tourism, but I tried and tried to get any mistake or shortcoming from you, but unfortunately you didn’t give me a chance to get anything. 👏🏻
Many and many thanks and appreciation for the professionalism of high-class dealings and the speed of response, especially the driver Mohammed, he was very wonderful and respectful and was very cooperative and professional in the sense of the word. You made me happy on this most beautiful trip and I spent a lot of wonderful and special time in South Africa 🇿🇦.
And God willing, it will not be the last trip with you, and I wish you continued success and progress for the best and the best.
Thank you ❤️ SA

When I first booked my flights to south africa for my honey moon I was worried about moving around, I booked with Mohammed VIP driver service for the whole 10 days, it exceeded my expectations. Mohammed was professional, on time and took us around special places. If I ever will go to south africa I will definitely book with them again.
Trustworthy and knowledgeable drivers with clean vehicles.
